title: Disagreement-Restricted Certificates for Swapping LLM Calls to Cheap Classifiers

intervention_object.acts_on: the gold-label acquisition rule and estimand of a pre-swap certificate: which logged calls receive human labels, and what quantity the lower confidence bound is about
intervention_object.operator: a partition of the held-out log into the label-free agreement bulk (paired accuracy change identically zero) and nested disagreement shells indexed by candidate confidence, followed by a fixed-sequence anytime-valid lower bound on the ground-truth paired accuracy change computed from shell-restricted gold labels and exact log-derived shell weights
intervention_object.decision_variables: the deployed migration threshold tau* (largest certified migrated share, full migration included) and, at each sampling step, which shell supplies the next item to label (drawn by the mechanism's categorical shell selector) and when to stop buying labels for the current hypothesis

hook: We certify the ground-truth accuracy change of swapping an LLM call to a cheap typed classifier while buying gold labels only on logged calls where the candidate disagrees with the incumbent's logged answer, because on the agreement bulk the paired change is identically zero whatever the truth is. Against the strongest ground-truth certificates (a gold-only paired test; Conformal LLM Routing's Clopper-Pearson gate) it is never worse on their binding axis — gold labels per call site — at equal epsilon and delta, and its confidence width at a fixed label count contracts by the disagreement mass p_d (derived from the stratified variance identity).
hook_shape_rationale: (i) Shape (c): the strongest ground-truth baselines' load-bearing axis is gold labels drawn from the whole traffic, and the variance of our estimator p_d * mean_D(d) at n labels is p_d^2 * Var_D(d)/n, which is at most the uniform-sampling variance (p_d * E_D[d^2] - p_d^2 * mu_D^2)/n for every n because p_d <= 1 (derived), with range-based bounds shrinking by the factor p_d. (ii) Shape (a) was viable — agreement-type certificates increasingly block truly safe swaps as incumbent error grows while ours is invariant — but Phase 1 already diagnosed that bias, so the direction is not sharply non-obvious to readers of BARGAIN/SMART; shape (b) was rejected because the oracle-as-reference assumption is already named in published practice.

gap_closure.gap: (additive; site: frontier leaves BARGAIN openalex:W7109229324, Conformal Cascade dblp:journals/corr/abs-2607-25018, No Free Lunch openalex:W4414588259) No retrieved leaf produces a valid, non-vacuous bound on the ground-truth accuracy CHANGE caused by substituting a candidate for the incumbent while drawing most of its evidence from the incumbent's free logged outputs: agreement certificates over-charge the candidate by the incumbent's own error mass, ground-truth certificates ignore the logs and pay gold labels at the full 1/epsilon^2 rate, and the proxy-plus-gold leaves analyse single-population estimands in which the proxy is not also a comparison arm — stakes: a practitioner with a 1–2 point tolerance either rejects swaps that are actually safe whenever the frontier model's own error on noisy business labels exceeds the tolerance (forfeiting the savings), or pays on the order of thousands of gold labels per call site (Hoeffding at epsilon=0.02, delta=0.05 needs roughly 3.7k), which for low-volume call sites exceeds the API savings the swap was meant to capture.
gap_closure.how_closed: closed by pivoting the certificate's budgeted acquisition rule: the reference assumption (incumbent = truth) is replaced by the ground-truth paired estimand, and the uniform-acquisition assumption is replaced by label purchase restricted to label-free disagreement shells with exact log-derived weights, with the performance certificate re-derived as a fixed-sequence anytime-valid lower bound whose width scales with the disagreement mass (corpus support thin in this domain: C11's exemplars are bandit/selection papers, so the entry is judged against its abstract relax-then-re-certify steps).

core_mechanism: Let L be a held-out slice of the call site's request log (disjoint from any data used to train or select the candidate), each record carrying the input x and the incumbent's served answer I(x); replaying the deterministic candidate on L gives C(x) and a label-free confidence s_C(x) (the typed classifier's native class probability, or any score the candidate emits). Fix user tolerance epsilon and risk delta, and a decreasing threshold grid tau_1 > ... > tau_M with tau_M = -infinity meaning full migration (M chosen by the practitioner; no multiplicity penalty, see below); the migrated set is A(tau) = {x : s_C(x) >= tau}, and calls outside A(tau) keep the incumbent. With Y the blind gold label, the per-call paired change is d(x) = 1{C(x)=Y} - 1{I(x)=Y} in {-1,0,+1}, and the estimand is Delta_P(tau) = E_{x~P_log}[1{x in A(tau)} d(x)], the ground-truth accuracy change of migrating A(tau) on the logged traffic distribution P_log. The pivot rests on one algebraic fact: whenever C(x) = I(x), d(x) = 0 for every possible Y, so the agreement bulk carries zero information and the incumbent's own errors there are irrelevant to Delta — the bias that makes BARGAIN/SMART-style agreement certificates loose disappears without estimating incumbent error. Partition the disagreements into nested shells R_i = (A(tau_i) minus A(tau_{i-1})) intersected with {C != I}, whose weights w_i = |R_i|/|L| are computed from the log with zero labels, so p_d(tau_j) = sum_{i<=j} w_i and Delta_L(tau_j) = p_d(tau_j) * mu_D(tau_j), where mu_D(tau_j) is the mean of d over the disagreement set D(tau_j) = union of R_1..R_j. Labels are bought only inside shells: each shell owns a seeded i.i.d. uniform-with-replacement stream of items with a label cache, and hypothesis j consumes them through an i.i.d. categorical shell selector with probabilities w_i/p_d(tau_j), which yields an i.i.d. uniform sample over D(tau_j) while reusing every label bought for earlier (smaller) hypotheses. On that sample a variance-adaptive betting confidence sequence (the anytime-valid tool of n8, a parametric node used here as a component) gives a lower bound LCB_D(tau_j) on mu_D(tau_j) at level delta_lab, valid under the mechanism's own optional stopping; the superpopulation certificate then lowers it by two label-free slacks — a binomial bound on p_d from |L| and a Hoeffding term on |mu_D,L - mu_D,P| from the unlabeled count |D_L(tau_j)| — at level delta_pop, with delta_lab + delta_pop = delta (split rule: assign delta_pop the smallest share that keeps its slack below the label-term width, since it is paid only in unlabeled counts), and Delta_P(tau_j) is certified when p_d^(+/-) * (LCB_D - slack) >= -epsilon, using the upper bound of p_d when the bracket is negative. Hypotheses H_j: Delta_P(tau_j) < -epsilon are tested in the fixed order j = 1..M (smallest to largest migrated share), stopping at the first that cannot be rejected within label budget B, so the family-wise error is at most delta without a union bound (fixed-sequence testing); the CI gate deploys tau* = the last certified threshold, and passes full migration only if tau_M is certified.
core_mechanism_reasoning: BLOCK 1 — PREMISES. (P1, definitional) On calls where C(x) = I(x) the paired change d is exactly zero for any gold label — true by algebra, it is what makes the agreement bulk label-free. (P2, OBSERVATION-MODEL) The certification slice L is an i.i.d. (or uniformly subsampled) draw of the call site's traffic over the logging window, disjoint from the candidate's training/selection data, and I(x) is the answer the incumbent actually served — believed because request logs record served responses and the split is enforced by construction; leakage (certifying on distillation data) would shrink p_d and make the bound anti-conservative, and the certificate covers P_log, not post-swap traffic (deferred gap). (P3, OBSERVATION-MODEL) Gold labels are produced blind — the annotator sees the input and option set, never either model's answer — so annotator error is independent of which arm is shown; correctness is defined by this label process; whether annotator error concentrates on disagreement items (which are harder) is untested — falsification target (secondary). (P4) The candidate is deterministic (argmax, temperature 0) so replayed C(x) equals its deployed output — typed classifiers satisfy this natively. (P5) Viable cheap candidates for classification-shaped calls, especially ones distilled on the incumbent's logs, disagree with the incumbent on a small mass p_d of traffic — untested — falsification target; label savings scale with it. ESTIMAND: Delta_P(tau) = E_{x~P_log}[1{s_C(x) >= tau} (1{C(x)=Y(x)} - 1{I(x)=Y(x)})], Y the blind gold-label process; the claim is P(Delta_P(tau*) >= -epsilon) >= 1 - delta over gold-label sampling and the log draw; the estimator (shell-selector sample over D(tau), times exact p_d, minus unlabeled slacks) targets exactly this product decomposition. BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT. Naive version: draw n gold labels uniformly from logged traffic, compute paired differences, and accept the swap if a Hoeffding/McNemar-style lower bound (or PPI++ with the incumbent's answer as the proxy) on Delta is at least -epsilon. Branch (i): it silently relies on the premise that label-bearing information is spread over the population, which is false here — on the label-free agreement set of mass 1 - p_d the paired change is deterministically zero, so that share of every uniformly spent label is wasted; PPI's correlation-threshold analysis (No Free Lunch, openalex:W4414588259) does not describe this case because the rectifier is exactly zero on agreements, not merely correlated, yet uniform acquisition still pays for those calls. STANDARD-TOOL FOLLOW-UP: the textbook tool is stratified sampling with known weights / the difference estimator (n0a) plus Neyman allocation; the domain-specific structure that this instance adds is (1) the zero-variance stratum is defined by one of the two compared systems and is computable over the entire log at replay cost, (2) the decision is a nested family of partial migrations whose disagreement shells are nested, so one label pool must serve a fixed-sequence test through shared shell streams and a per-hypothesis shell selector, and (3) weights are exact on the log, so the superpopulation correction is paid in unlabeled counts only; when p_d is not small the method degrades to stratified gold-only testing and the contribution is application-grade there — stated, not hidden. Avoided nodes: n0 (uniform paired acceptance test), n10/n12 (PPI/active inference with the incumbent as proxy), c3 (single-model active risk estimation), n0a (survey difference estimator without certificate), L1 (BARGAIN's oracle-agreement threshold test) — the mechanism changes what is certified (ground-truth paired change, not agreement), over which population (P_log, not the sampled finite set) and with which evidence (labels only on label-free-identified shells). BLOCK 3 — RATIONALE. (a) Anchor-only: the post-swap and answer-space gaps would need separate machinery and no object of theirs is consumed by this certificate, so they were deferred rather than bolted on. (b) Rejected alternatives: correcting an agreement certificate by estimating the incumbent's error with latent-truth or agreement-based estimators (c1/c2) needs independence assumptions and gives no finite-sample guarantee; adaptive importance allocation inside D by candidate confidence was considered but kept out of the core because data-dependent weights complicate anytime validity and the dominant gain comes from the zero stratum, not within-D allocation; a single union-bounded test over all thresholds was rejected for fixed-sequence testing, which needs no multiplicity correction.
core_mechanism_steps: 1. Split the call site's request log by time-stratified random assignment into L_train (optional, used to distil or select the candidate) and L_cert; input: logged (x, I(x)) records; output: L_cert with a recorded split seed, asserted disjoint from every record the candidate saw. 2. Replay the deterministic candidate on L_cert to obtain C(x) and s_C(x); output: per-record agreement flag 1{C(x)=I(x)}; zero gold labels used. 3. Given the threshold grid tau_1..tau_M (practitioner-chosen, swept in evaluation), compute migrated sets A(tau_j), disagreement shells R_i, exact weights w_i and p_d(tau_j); output: a shell table — if p_d(tau_M) = 0 the full-migration certificate is immediate up to the label-free slack. 4. For each shell create a seeded uniform-with-replacement item stream and an empty label cache; output: lazily evaluated streams. 5. For hypothesis j = 1..M in order: repeatedly draw a shell index from Categorical(w_i/p_d(tau_j)), take that shell's next stream item for this hypothesis, look up its label in the cache or send the input with the option set (no model answers shown, order-randomised) to the annotation queue, compute d and update the betting confidence sequence on mu_D(tau_j); stop when the certified bound on Delta_P(tau_j) clears -epsilon (move to j+1), when the confidence sequence's upper bound shows Delta_P(tau_j) < -epsilon, or when cumulative labels reach budget B (stop the sequence). 6. Convert the confidence-sequence bound to the Delta_P certificate using exact p_d, the binomial bound on p_d from |L_cert| and the Hoeffding slack from |D_L(tau_j)| at level delta_pop; output: per-hypothesis certified lower bound and label count. 7. Emit tau* = the last certified threshold and a certificate artifact (epsilon, delta, delta split, tau*, p_d, labels used, confidence-sequence trace, log slice hash) to the CI job; the gate fails the migration PR if no threshold is certified. 8. On merge, the router serves x with s_C(x) >= tau* by the candidate and the rest by the incumbent (tau* = tau_M retires the incumbent for that call site), which changes the answers production receives on exactly the certified share of traffic — the certificate's claim is about that served-answer change.
falsification_prediction: (a) Procedure: on public labelled classification sets (Banking77, AG News, MMLU treated as 4-way classification), simulate production logs by answering a held-out pool with an incumbent (Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct with local weights, and GPT-4o via API), take candidates that are DeBERTa-v3-base distilled on incumbent answers from a disjoint split and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct constrained to the option set, reveal gold labels only when the mechanism buys them, and compute the true Delta_P from all gold labels as the full-observation oracle; baselines are a gold-only paired test, PPI++ with the incumbent as proxy, the Conformal LLM Routing Clopper-Pearson gate, SMART, and a BARGAIN reconstruction labelled as such and swept over its unpinned parameters (M, oracle budget relative to ours, delta, P-U and P-A variants) per the Phase 1 hard constraint. (b) If the candidate works: gold labels consumed to reach a decision at fixed (epsilon, delta) and the certified migrated share at fixed budget B are no worse than every ground-truth baseline and improve as p_d falls; the empirical violation rate of the certificate (certified tau* whose true Delta_P < -epsilon) stays at or below delta; and when incumbent strength is varied (weaker incumbents), agreement-type baselines block an increasing share of truly safe swaps while our accept decisions are invariant to incumbent error on agreement items. (c) Load-bearing variable: the disagreement mass p_d(tau) defined by the label-free partition. Negative control — ablate its producer by acquiring labels uniformly from the whole migrated set A(tau) with the same confidence-sequence machinery (equivalently, treating every call as a shell member): labels-to-decision and certified migrated share must fall back to the gold-only curve; dose-response — certifying earlier distillation checkpoints with larger p_d must raise labels-to-decision, with confidence width at fixed label count proportional to p_d for range-based sequences (derived: the estimator is p_d times a [-1,1]-bounded mean). A leakage control (certifying on L_train) should push the violation rate above delta, isolating premise P2; a positive control with p_d and mu_D supplied by the oracle bounds the best achievable label count.
compute_budget: about 8 GPU-day (Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct incumbent answers over the pools, DeBERTa-v3-base distillation runs and Qwen2.5-1.5B replays; Monte Carlo certificate reruns are CPU) + about $1.5k API (GPT-4o incumbent answers and API-oracle calls for the BARGAIN/SMART reconstructions); comfortable against the 150 GPU-day / $10k envelope.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: BARGAIN certifies agreement with the oracle LLM on the finite dataset it samples, labelling uniformly from all records above a proxy threshold; we certify the ground-truth accuracy change over the logged traffic distribution and buy labels only on the label-free disagreement shells of each threshold, so incumbent errors on agreements neither inflate the bound nor consume labels.

Conformal Cascade bounds per-tier miscoverage from a gold-labelled calibration set covering all traffic and keeps the large model as a fallback tier; we bound the paired accuracy change of retiring the incumbent and use the incumbent's logs to restrict gold labels to the disagreement set with exact weights.

SMART bounds the probability of deviating from the reference LLM's outputs with binomial intervals; we bound deviation from ground truth relative to the incumbent's own accuracy, so a candidate that is as accurate as the incumbent but errs on different items passes (abstract-only inference for SMART's internals).

Conformal LLM Routing calibrates a routed-query violation rate with Clopper-Pearson on correctness labels drawn from the whole calibration set; we certify the change relative to the incumbent and draw gold labels only where the two arms disagree, which a violation-rate estimand cannot exploit because candidate errors on incumbent-agreement items still count against it.

No Free Lunch characterises when proxy-plus-gold mean estimation beats gold-only through a proxy-truth correlation threshold for a single population; we construct a paired-comparison certificate in which the proxy is one of the compared arms, making the correction term exactly zero on a label-free stratum so the gain needs no correlation condition.

Active Statistical Inference allocates labels by model uncertainty for single-population estimands; our acquisition is restricted by the deterministic arm-disagreement partition and shared across a nested fixed-sequence family of partial migrations.

C3PO learns label-free exit rules from cheap-model/MPM consistency and guarantees cost, not accuracy; we use the same consistency signal only to locate where gold labels can matter and certify ground-truth accuracy change.

what_step_was_missed: BARGAIN's threshold test would already be this certificate if its per-record statistic I[O(x)=1] (agreement with the oracle) were replaced by the ground-truth paired difference 1{C=Y} - 1{I=Y}, its sampling distribution over S^rho were restricted to the label-free disagreement subset of S^rho with the subset's exact share carried as a known multiplier, and its finite-dataset guarantee were extended to the traffic distribution by slack terms paid in unlabeled counts — a change of estimand and of the sampling support that its oracle-as-truth framing never constructs.
